As am I. I first joined reddit in the early 2000s. I'd probably spent well over $5k on the site and site related activities (donation, various charities, pizza, SecretSanta, et al). To add to that, I did a whole lot of artwork for the site in making custom Snoos for various things. If you 404 a reddit page and see the little confused Snoo... that is me.

http://subarukayak.imgur.com/all/

http://www.redditblog.com/2010/05/reddits-may-2010-state-of-servers.html

Alexis tweeted about this bit once... http://i.imgur.com/ntZsb.png

I am the artist that created the revised 404s and the little "You Broke Reddit" pics. I also did a bit of work for sales and such for E3. I was an active participant on several of the art related subs. I helped a little in getting the Secret Santa bits off the ground the first time around. That's just the big bits I can remember right off... oh, and /r/fffffffuuuuuuuuuuu was party my fault.

The bits of 'making things better for everyone else' resonated with me. I was involved with reddit because I liked the community and felt connected to something far more powerful than myself. For Donor's choose I bought a $2k telescope for middle school kids in Oakland. I've picked up local redditors in Dallas and gave them rides to the airport, volunteered for various disasters championed by the reddit community.

I think I just broke my arm patting myself on the back... to be short- I liked the old reddit. It was my online home for almost a decade. I didn't leave reddit all 'willy nilly' in a huff. It's been a long time coming. I am relieved and disappointed.
